ownerDirective.summary: Owner reviewed the current SCHOOL_TREATMENT_ROOM preview: acceptable as an ENGINEERING/PHYSICS VALIDATION ENVIRONMENT, NOT acceptable as the target visual world of the Ko Rishon simulator. Two explicit layers established: (1) PHYSICS/AUTHORITY - existing certified geometry, surfaces, supports, collision bodies, physical bodies, gates; (2) PRESENTATION/WORLD - high-quality environment rendered from and bound to the authoritative physical world, never replacing or bypassing layer 1. Decorative meshes are never authoritative unless separately certified; presentation never invents positions, supports or collisions. R1/R2/R3 continue uninterrupted.

claimsRule: Nothing in the listed artifacts is visual/world completion. The simulator world is not 'visually complete' until a production-quality scene actually runs from the same authoritative world state. Engineering validation value of the listed artifacts is unchanged.
layerModel: SceneDefinition -> Authoritative Physical Scene -> Presentation Manifest -> Visual Assets -> Entity Bindings -> Renderer (stable entity IDs connect physical entities to visual entities; see docs/track-b/production-world-track-plan.md)
